entity.summary: Dutch centralized crypto-asset platform offering current exchange, custody, transfer, and earn-related services under the Coinmerce brand.
entity.notes: Current first-party terms identify Coinmerce B.V. as the Dutch client counterparty and state that it has offered crypto-asset services since 2017 under a MiCAR crypto-asset service provider authorization. The current platform exposes buy, sell, swap, custody, and related services. HEI leaves launch_date null because the reviewed material establishes a service year rather than a definitive public launch day.

evidence.title: Coinmerce General Terms and Conditions
evidence.notes: Current terms identify Coinmerce B.V., its Dutch registration, client-counterparty role, exchange and custody services, and MiCAR authorization.

evidence.title: Coinmerce official platform and company profile
evidence.notes: Current first-party page reports an active Dutch crypto platform with more than 350 supported assets and current buy, sell, swap, and custody access.
